title: New Music discs!
description: this project is about adding new music discs to an older version of minecraft
body:
This mod was made by kindodoggybro4

to use this mod you have to put it in the mods folder get forge 1.19.2 installed and you're Done! it should then work

This mod allows new music discs to be in older minecraft versions such as 1.19.2

and it adds new/custom music discs

and some custom discs are gonna be even better

this mod was inspired by ALOT OFF MODS

credits to mojang for making the music discs

i just made this mod for people to have fun with an old version off minecraft while having new music discs!
